# SLOT2 SNES slot trim

The original SNES slot trim is from [goosetopPM/slot2](https://github.com/goosetopPM/slot2)
at commit `a4f5ecf02ede01230dd1ff974d7dd607016d9d84` (MIT, copyright 2026 SLOT2 contributors).
The upstream `LICENSE` and `assets/skins/PROVENANCE.md` are preserved here. No other SLOT2
assets, code or emulator cores are included.

- `snes_port.svg`: transparent-centred mouth trim, 294×58.

The cartridge drawings are our own regional shells in `tools/themebuild/assets/`.
